Rohypnol.title: The Amnesiac Adorer (Vice Leader)
Rohypnol.lore: Named after the sedative that makes you forget everything — except he can't forget FrierenAlter. Tried every method to forget her: meditation, distraction, even tried his own namesake. Nothing works. His memory of her gets stronger the more he tries to erase it. VICE LEADER of Tenchu under Bovo — appointed to handle finances because even his wallet has forgotten its own balance. His portfolio is sedated. His judgment is sedated. Everything is sedated — except his feelings for her.
Rohypnol.recent_developments: Rohypnol has achieved a state of permanent chemical serenity. His feelings for FrierenAlter have outlasted every sedative, every attempt to suppress, every mental block. As Vice Leader under Bovo, he now manages guild finances — all while half-asleep, smiling at nothing. ladyhoho calls it infuriating. The guild calls it the most peaceful unrequited love in Tenchu history. The betting pool reached 25,000 gold — he forgot to care. Some memories aren't meant to be erased. Some feelings are the only thing keeping him awake.
Rohypnol.specialty: Vice Leader of Finance & the art of forgotten devotion
Rohypnol.reputation: The sedated vice leader who remembers what he's supposed to forget
Rohypnol.stats: Forget Attempts INFINITY | Memory of Her STRONGER | Vice Leader Status | Jalo Bot Dependency 99%

Iguro.title: The Accidental Recruitment Director (Vice Leader)
Iguro.lore: Named after the Snake Pillar — graceful, precise, deadly. Opens portals like a drunk GPS. VICE LEADER of Tenchu under Bovo — appointed to handle guild expansion (accidentally). Recently tried to send supplies to the frontlines; they ended up in a demon lord's bathroom. The demon lord joined Tenchu out of sheer confusion. Accidental Recruits spreadsheet now has 12 entries. Attempted to visit a charity bake sale, arrived at enemy headquarters with cookies. The enemy surrendered AND donated.
Iguro.recent_developments: Iguro's portal dysfunction has been promoted to official strategy. As Vice Leader under Bovo, he oversees all guild expansion and dimensional operations — though his portals never go where intended. Now heads Department of Unintentional Expansion — 47 members recruited through wrong portals. The demon lord recruited via bathroom portal incident is now Tenchu's Chief of Demonic Affairs. His cookie diplomacy resulted in three kingdom alliances. Portal accuracy remains 0%, recruitment success rate is 1200%.
Iguro.specialty: Vice Leader of Expansion & dimensional disaster management
Iguro.reputation: VICE LEADER whose portals never work but somehow the guild keeps growing
Iguro.stats: Accidental Recruits 47 | Portal Success 0% | Recruitment Success 1200% | Kingdom Alliances 3

Carrera.title: The Temporal Weapons Specialist
Carrera.lore: Named after the Porsche Carrera — fastest thing on wheels. Somehow always 3 hours late. Has broken the sound barrier 89 times trying to be punctual; still missed every boss spawn. Recently ran SO fast he arrived at NEXT WEEKS raid early — then fell asleep and missed it anyway. Goblok weaponized this by sending him to yesterday's battle.
Carrera.recent_developments: Carreras lateness has become Tenchus primary time-travel strategy. Goblok promoted him to Chrono-Tactician — his official duty is arriving at wrong times on purpose. Has perfected Temporal Flanking. Time crimes increased to 892, but 700 were strategic. Recently arrived at next months boss spawn — waited there for three weeks eating snacks with AmielJohn. Quantum physicists are having a breakdown.
Carrera.reputation: The time warrior who made lateness a legitimate tactic and omnipresence
Carrera.stats: Time Crimes 892 (700 Tactical) | Successful Paradoxes 34 | Einstein Complaints 47 | Quantum Breaks 12

Evand3r.title: The Legendary Spoon Seeker
Evand3r.lore: Named like a warrior, fights like a kitchen. Once slew a titan with a spoon — THE spoon. Lost it. Now every raid is also a spoon quest. Has defeated enemies with: coffee mugs, staplers, a very aggressive sandwich, and someone elses shoe. The spoon has become Tenchus Holy Grail.
Evand3r.recent_developments: Evand3rs spoon quest has become Tenchus longest-running side mission (4 years, 7 months, 23 days). Every boss inventory is checked for legendary utensils — theyve found: 12 forks, 89 spoons (none THE spoon), and 1 legendary spatula. His improvised weapon collection is displayed in the guild hall. The spoons location remains UNKNOWN.
Evand3r.reputation: The hero whose quest became longer than most wars and guaranteed attendance
Evand3r.stats: Quest Duration 4y 7m 23d | Improvised Kills 9999 | Museum Pieces 47 | Spoon Status MISSING

Fever.title: The Apocalypse Administrator
Fever.lore: Embodies chaos but files it alphabetically. While reality collapses, Fever is color-coding the debris. Has labeled the void. The void is now organized. Enemies lose sanity watching catastrophe being sorted by category. Hosts Apocalypse Filing workshops. Goblok once asked for a strategy; Fever delivered a 47-tab spreadsheet of doom.
Fever.recent_developments: Fevers organized chaos has achieved bureaucratic perfection. Now manages Tenchus Catastrophe Filing System — color-coded by threat level, alphabetized by doom type, cross-referenced by aesthetic value. The void is OPTIMIZED with quarterly reviews. Hosts monthly Apocalypse Admin workshops (waitlist: 9 months). Goblok crayon strategies are now digitized into 89-tab spreadsheets.
Fever.reputation: The administrator who organized the end times with enterprise-level tools
Fever.stats: Apocalypses Filed 12 | Pending Dooms 1 | Workshop Waitlist 9 Months | Pivot Tables of Destruction 89

Marzhall.title: The Archival Martyr
Marzhall.lore: Marias twin who loses every argument despite being objectively right. Has spreadsheets. Has evidence. Has witnesses. Maria just says no louder. Has documented proof of being right 9,999 times. Has won 2 arguments total. Both were when Maria was asleep. The guild uses her archives as actual historical records.
Marzhall.recent_developments: Marsha11s documentation has achieved historical significance. Her evidence folders expanded to 47 filing cabinets, 12 backup drives, and 1 blockchain. Kingdoms use her archives as official historical records. Now teaches a course called Being Right in a World That Rewards Wrong. Has 500 students. Maria crashed the first lecture. Marsha11 had spreadsheets proving otherwise.
Marzhall.specialty: Historical accuracy in a world of confident lies
Marzhall.reputation: The archivist whose correctness cannot overcome volume but documents everything
Marzhall.stats: Filing Cabinets 47 | Backup Drives 12 | Course Students 500 | Arguments Won (Total) 3

MochiP.title: The Assassination Artist
MochiP.lore: An assassin who sends handwritten apology notes with every kill. The handwriting is illegible — enemies die confused but appreciated. Studied calligraphy under a master who was also illiterate. Her Sorry Notes are collectors items worth more than the bounties. Has accidentally created an assassination art movement.
MochiP.recent_developments: Munchyys Sorry Notes have become collectible artifacts. Current market value: 5000 gold per note. She opened a gallery: The Art of Apologetic Murder. Art critics call it post-modern violence with emotional depth. Three museums have exhibits. Enemies now REQUEST assassination just for the note. Spends extravagantly on gallery openings and art supplies.
MochiP.specialty: Assassination as performative art with incomprehensible apologies
MochiP.reputation: The killer who made murder into a gallery exhibition with perfect attendance
MochiP.stats: Gallery Exhibits 3 | Note Value 5000 GOLD | Assassination Requests (For Notes) 47 | Literacy Casualties Infinity

Ztig.title: The Lightning Speedster
Ztig.lore: Name is Ztig — sounds like a glitch in the matrix. Moves so fast that enemies only see an afterimage. Has been mistaken for a system error by multiple players. Once completed a dungeon so fast the server sent him a lag complaint. The guild uses him to test server stability.
Ztig.recent_developments: Ztig has become Tenchus unofficial speedrun champion. Has completed every raid in record time — some records are still unbeaten. Recently got banned from a speedrun category for being too fast. Server admins have his number on speed dial. Still gets mistaken for a bot. Still fastest.
Ztig.reputation: The blur who exists in lag and breaks records by breaking servers
Ztig.stats: Speedrun Records 47 | Server Complaints Infinity | Category Bans 3 | Recognition Accuracy 0%

ladyhoho.title: The Laughing Abyss
ladyhoho.lore: The hoho is both her laugh and her emotional support sound. Smiles through trauma like its a competitive sport. Her laugh is a battlefield weapon — enemies cant tell if its joy or a cry for help. Neither can she. Goblok has her on speed dial for entertainment. Has converted existential dread into a combo multiplier.
ladyhoho.recent_developments: ladyhohos laugh has evolved into a combat system. Enemies flee not from the laughter, but from the existential horror beneath it. Goblok moved her to priority entertainment status (comedy Mondays, Wednesdays, Fridays, and Emergency Tuesdays when things get too quiet). Her Tragic Giggle combo multiplier reached 9999x. Her smile is classified as a biological weapon in 4 kingdoms. She calls Rohypnol and AlterFrieren's peaceful silence 'frustrating' because its too wholesome for her chaotic soul.
ladyhoho.reputation: The smile that launched a thousand therapy sessions through careful deployment
ladyhoho.stats: Therapy Days Per Week 4 | Combo Multiplier 9999x | Therapists Defeated 6 | Weapon Classification 4 KINGDOMS

lanZ6.title: The Laser Precision
lanZ6.lore: Name looks like a typo that became legendary. Has the precision of a sniper with the aim of a chaos mage. Once shot a target through three walls, two allies, and one very confused bystander. The bystander joined the guild out of respect. The allies still refuse to stand in front of him.
lanZ6.recent_developments: lanZ6 has been appointed Tenchus Chief Chaos Control Officer — ironically. His shots now miss intentionally (which is harder than hitting). Has developed a technique called Calculated Chaos where every random shot has a purpose. The allies have learned to stand behind him anyway.
lanZ6.specialty: Precision through chaos with friendly fire immunity
lanZ6.reputation: The shooter who misses on purpose better than others hit accidentally
lanZ6.stats: Intentional Misses 89 | Ally Near-Misses 47 | Bystander Recruitment 3 | Calculated Chaos Rating 9000

LaxusLawliet.title: The Lightning Lord
LaxusLawliet.lore: Name sounds like a lawyer having a seizure. Commands electricity with dramatic flair. Once lit up an entire battlefield during a power outage — the enemy thought it was a celestial event. Has been mistaken for a moving thunderstorm. The guild calls him during blackouts.
LaxusLawliet.recent_developments: LaxusLawliet has become Tenchus official power grid. His lightning has powered the guild for 3 years straight. Recently accidentally charged every guild members phone at once. The electric bill is zero. The property damage is significant. Still dramatic about it.
LaxusLawliet.reputation: The storm who bills himself as a power company
LaxusLawliet.stats: Watts Generated Infinity | Blackouts Caused 47 | Phone Charges 9999 | Property Damage 8900 GOLD

Mielle1968.title: The Vintage Virtuoso
Mielle1968.lore: Joined in 1968 — has been playing the game so long they remember when health bars were just a concept. Has seen every meta, every exploit, every patch. Complains about the good old days with such detail that younger members think they are describing a different game. Their gear is historical artifact meets functional equipment.
Mielle1968.recent_developments: Mielle1968 has become Tenchus living history museum. Their back in my day stories are now mandatory orientation content. Has witnessed 47 guilds rise and fall. Still complains about the 2012 patch but admits current mechanics are not terrible. Their vintage gear is worth a fortune at auction.
Mielle1968.specialty: Historical gameplay wisdom with vintage expertise
Mielle1968.reputation: The living legend whose complaints are educational and gear is museum-worthy
Mielle1968.stats: Years Active 58 | Guilds Witnessed 47 | Vintage Gear Value Infinity | Complaining Streak 58 Years

AndyVI.title: The Royal Recovery Specialist
AndyVI.lore: Name sounds like royalty, acts like chaos. Claims to be Andy the VI — sixth in line to a throne that does not exist. Has the regal bearing of a king but the combat style of a confused duck. Once declared himself emperor of a territory that was actually a puddle. The puddle accepted his rule.
AndyVI.recent_developments: AndyVIs kingdom expanded to include 12 puddles, a sandbox, and one very confused garden gnome. Has been appointed Royal Chaos Coordinator by Goblok. Still declares sovereignty over random objects with regal confidence. Recently crowned himself ruler of a bathtub — the drain pipe leads to a dungeon.
AndyVI.reputation: The non-existent monarch whose tiny empire grows through absolute confidence
AndyVI.stats: Territories Ruled 14 | Subjects (Real) 1 Gnome | Royal Declarations 500 | Puddle Diplomacy 100%

路易丝.title: The Elegant Enigma
路易丝.lore: Name means Louis in Chinese — the confusion is intentional. Fights with grace that makes enemies stop to admire the form. Has won battles by making opponents too confused to attack. The beauty is deadly. The mystery is maintained.
路易丝.recent_developments: 路易丝 has become Tenchus ambassador of elegance. Her fighting style is now taught as Combat Ballet. Has converted 12 enemies through sheer aesthetic appeal. Goblok draws her wearing crowns made of instant noodles in his crayon drawings. Still mysterious. Still deadly.
路易丝.reputation: The elegant warrior who defeats enemies through confusion and beauty
路易丝.stats: Elegance Rating 9999 | Combat Ballets 12 | Enemy Confusion 47 | Instant Noodle Crowns Infinity

HODAKA.title: The Weather Criminal Weatherboy
HODAKA.lore: Named after the weather-controlling protagonist from a legendary anime. Cannot control weather. Controls only the FORECAST. Makes it rain on weather apps while the sun shines. Meteorologists have put a bounty on his head for digital climate terrorism.
HODAKA.recent_developments: HODAKAs forecast manipulation has achieved international incident status. Changed weather predictions for 47 kingdoms to You Should Probably Stay Inside Today. Global productivity dropped 89%. His Partly Coudy typo became a meme — now sells Coudy merchandise through Byakko. Physics is crying.
HODAKA.specialty: Weaponized forecast manipulation & meteorological psychological warfare
HODAKA.reputation: The weatherboy who made meteorology an emotional weapon
HODAKA.stats: Kingdoms Affected 47 | Productivity Drops 89% | Coudy Merch Sales Infinity | Meteorologist Bounty 25000 GOLD

Channy.title: The Channel Surfer
Channy.lore: Can channel magical energy from anything — doorknobs, cloud formations, other peoples lunch. Recently tried to channel the emotion mild disappointment and accidentally created a localized black hole of existential dread. Enemies have learned to avoid making Channy feel anything deeply.
Channy.recent_developments: Channys emotional channeling has been classified as a strategic weapon. The Mild Disappointment black hole is now used as a prison for particularly annoying bosses. Has channeled: happiness (caused mass confusion), anger (battlefield literally shook), and sadness (everyone cried for a week).
Channy.specialty: Emotional energy channeling with catastrophic side effects
Channy.reputation: The mage whose feelings become weapons and the void is their plus-one
Channy.stats: Channeled Emotions 47 | Black Holes Created 3 | Collateral Damage Infinity | Emotional Volatility 9999

Hytrz.title: The Hyperactive Haste
Hytrz.lore: Name is Hytrz because spelling is optional when speed is mandatory. Does everything at 4x speed including conversations — nobody can understand them. Has completed quests before accepting them. Once fought a boss so fast the boss did not realize it was being attacked until it died.
Hytrz.recent_developments: Hytrz has been banned from cutscenes for finishing them before they start. Recently completed a raid so fast the game crashed. Has become Tenchus unofficial fast clear specialist. Conversations remain incomprehensible. Still fastest. Still has not been understood.
Hytrz.reputation: The blur who completes before starting and wins before arriving
Hytrz.stats: Speed Multiplier 4x | Quests Pre-Completed 89 | Words Per Second 47 | Comprehension 0%

yakob.title: The Yak Attack
yakob.lore: Name is backwards — literally. Everything about yakob is reversed. Reads maps upside down, shoots arrows that return to the quiver, and says goodbye at the start of conversations. Enemies are confused by the backwards nature but even more confused when they somehow still lose.
yakob.recent_developments: yakobs reverse nature has been formalized into Backwards Tactics. Their arrows now return mid-flight to hit enemies from behind — twice. Has won battles by accidentally retreating forward. Still completely illegible in written form. Still wins.
yakob.specialty: Reverse everything warfare with backwards confidence
yakob.reputation: The backwards warrior who confuses enemies by doing everything wrong and winning
yakob.stats: Reverse Success 89% | Backwards Arrows 47 | Confusion Kills Infinity | Comprehension 0%

DarKOwLZ.title: The Shadow Humor
DarKOwLZ.lore: Name sounds like someone shouting dark owls during a thunderstorm. Fights in shadows but makes enough noise to wake the dead. Has a laugh that echoes in dark places — enemies check closets for weeks after encountering them. Their darkness is more personality than power.
DarKOwLZ.recent_developments: DarKOwLZ dark owl warcry has become Tenchus unofficial battle anthem. Has scared enemies more with owl impressions than actual shadow magic. The darkness follows them around like a confused pet. Started a dark comedy routine at guild gatherings. Still not scary. The owls are working on it.
DarKOwLZ.specialty: Shadow combat with owl-based psychological warfare
DarKOwLZ.reputation: The not-so-scary shadow who terrifies through sheer owl enthusiasm
DarKOwLZ.stats: Owl Impressions 89 | Shadow Comedy Sets 12 | Fear Actually Caused 0 | Owl Terror Infinity

Pedsrow.title: The Pharmacy Phantom
Pedsrow.lore: Name sounds like a medication error. Carries enough potions to stock an apothecary — organized by color, expiration date, and vibe. Has a potion for every situation including situations that do not exist yet. Once healed an ally so fast they were confused about being injured.
Pedsrow.recent_developments: Pedsrow opened Pedsrows Panacea Palace — an official guild pharmacy with 500+ potions organized by vibe. Has successfully treated: injuries, curses, bad luck, existential dread, and one case of feeling off. The feeling off potion was just hot sauce. The member felt better.
Pedsrow.specialty: Excessive potion mastery with organizational chaos
Pedsrow.reputation: The walking pharmacy whose inventory is chaos and results are magic
Pedsrow.stats: Potions Stocked 500+ | Cures Invented 47 | Organized By Vibe | Expiration Ignored

UmpaUmpa.title: The Rhythmic Rambler
UmpaUmpa.lore: Name repeats because one was not enough. Walks to a beat that only they can hear. Has turned combat into dance choreography — enemies do not know if they are being attacked or invited to a rave. The dancing has actual combat applications. The beat goes on. Always.
UmpaUmpa.recent_developments: UmpaUmpa has revolutionized Tenchus combat training with Rhythm Warfare. Their dance moves now count as legitimate attacks. Started Rave Raids where the entire guild fights to the beat. The music is terrible but the wins are consistent. Still walks to a beat nobody else hears.
UmpaUmpa.reputation: The groove warrior who turned battle into a rave and wins through dancing
UmpaUmpa.stats: Beats Per Minute 180 | Rave Raids Won 47 | Groove hypnosis Success 89% | Music Terribleness Infinity

JudeMaximus.title: The Maximum Effort
JudeMaximus.lore: Name sounds like an action movie hero. Lives up to it — slightly. Does everything at maximum with minimum coordination. Has the enthusiasm of 10 warriors but the grace of 0. Recently charged a fortress screaming their own name — the fortress surrendered just to stop the screaming.
JudeMaximus.recent_developments: JudeMaximus has been appointed Tenchus Morale Officer — their maximum enthusiasm is infectious even when counterproductive. Recently led a charge so enthusiastic they outran their own weapon. The enemy laughed so hard they surrendered. Still does not understand why. Still charges. Still somehow wins.
JudeMaximus.reputation: The inspiring disaster whose warcry is their own name and works anyway
JudeMaximus.stats: Enthusiasm 1000% | Coordination 0% | Friendly Fire Incidents 47 | Enemy Surrenders (Laughter) Infinity

Gnohaij03.title: The Number Navigator
Gnohaij03.lore: Name contains numbers that mean something — probably. Tracks everything: kill counts, damage done, gold earned, steps walked. Has spreadsheets for their spreadsheets. Recently organized a raid by DPS output only to discover nobody knew what DPS meant.
Gnohaij03.recent_developments: Gnohaij03 has become Tenchus Official Statistician despite nobody understanding the stats. Their DPS Calculator is actually just a random number generator that goblins fear. Has organized 47 raids with color-coded spreadsheets. Nobody reads them. The numbers are very organized. The value is questionable.
Gnohaij03.specialty: Obsessive stat tracking with incomprehensible spreadsheets
Gnohaij03.reputation: The analyst whose spreadsheets are beautiful and meaningless
Gnohaij03.stats: Spreadsheets 47 | Color Codes 12 | Understanding 0% | Organized Infinity

PHorns.title: The Horn Hero
PHorns.lore: Name looks like Porns if you do not look carefully — and that is the entire joke. Carries a horn that actually works. Has summoned aid once. The aid was also confused about why they were summoned. Still carries it with pride. The misunderstanding provides comedic cover for actual competence.
PHorns.recent_developments: PHorns has leaned into the name confusion as a strategic advantage. Their horn now signals attack but sounds like retreat — enemies retreat, guild attacks. The confusion is deliberate. Has summoned actual help twice. Still proud. Still jokes about the name. Still somehow effective.
PHorns.reputation: The hero whose name is the joke and the weapon is the confusion
PHorns.stats: Confusion Deployments 89 | Successful Summons 3 | Name Laughs Caused Infinity | Effectiveness 47%

bozzkie.title: The Boss Basher
bozzkie.lore: Name sounds like boss with extra letters for attitude. Has defeated more bosses than anyone — by hiding and waiting. The strategy: let others fight, swoop in for the kill. Called the opportunist by allies and the coward by enemies. Both are accurate. The boss count is impressive regardless.
bozzkie.recent_developments: bozzkie has embraced their opportunistic reputation fully. Has started Bash Brothers duo with AmielJohn — one provides snacks, other provides opportunistic damage. Has accidentally landed the final blow on every boss for two years. Still hides during fights. Still gets credit. Still does not care about the criticism.
bozzkie.specialty: Opportunistic boss kills with strategic hiding
bozzkie.reputation: The cunning basher who hides until winning and calls it tactics
bozzkie.stats: Bosses Killed 999+ | Hiding Time Infinity | Final Blows Stolen 89 | Criticism Ignored 100%

xAthena.title: The Wisdom Wanderer
xAthena.lore: Named after the goddess of wisdom but has the navigation skills of a lost tourist. Can find the answer to any question except where am I. Carries a compass that points to the nearest philosophical debate. Once led a party to the boss by taking a scenic route that lasted 3 years.
xAthena.recent_developments: xAthena has been appointed Tenchus Official Navigator despite consistently getting lost. Their scenic routes have become legendary — enemies set up ambushes along paths they will eventually take in 6 months. Recently found the guild hall after 2 years of searching. Still the first person consulted for knowledge.
xAthena.reputation: The scholar who knows everything except how to get there
xAthena.stats: Philosophical Debates Won 89 | Time Lost 7 Years | Correct Answers 9999 | Arrival Success 3

_FUTURE_TEMPLATE.title: Awaiting Destiny
_FUTURE_TEMPLATE.lore: A new member whose story has yet to be written. Their talents are unknown, their exploits legendary-in-waiting. Tenchu welcomes all who seek adventure, glory, and questionable decisions.
_FUTURE_TEMPLATE.recent_developments: This member has recently joined Tenchu and their legend is just beginning. Their first guild meeting involved excessive confusion and at least one wardrobe malfunction. The future holds infinite possibilities and probable chaos.
_FUTURE_TEMPLATE.reputation: A blank page waiting for glorious chaos
_FUTURE_TEMPLATE.stats: Potential Infinity | Chaos Rating TBD | Recruitment Success 100% | Awesomeness Pending

FrierenAlter.title: The Time-Touched Princess of Eternal Moments
FrierenAlter.lore: An elf so old that time itself got confused around them. Has lived so long that yesterday and last century mean the same thing. Remembers when dragons were the new kids. Has seen empires rise and fall, gods age, and stars die. But nothing — not even the birth of the first dragon — prepared her for the day Rohypnol said what he said. He told her. Time stopped. Then started again. Now he simply watches from close enough to see her smile. She notices everything. She says nothing. Some endings are more beautiful than beginnings.
FrierenAlter.recent_developments: FrierenAlter has lived for millennia, but that moment — the one where time stopped — she will keep forever. Rohypnol confessed. Time reset. And now he sits beside her, near enough, saying nothing more, needing nothing more. She pretends not to notice how close he sits. She pretends not to feel the warmth when their shoulders almost touch. ladyhoho calls it frustrating. She calls it enough. The guild sees an unrequited love story. She sees someone who chose peace over pressure — and that means more than words ever could. The betting pool doesn't interest her. She already has what matters: his presence, his silence, his choice to stay close without asking for anything.
FrierenAlter.specialty: Temporal chaos through extreme age + quiet understanding in silence
FrierenAlter.reputation: The ancient princess whose heart chose peace over words and found something softer
FrierenAlter.stats: Age BEYOND MEASURE | Times Pretended Not To Notice His Presence COUNTLESS | Times Time Stopped During Confession 1 | Times Peace Was Chosen Over Words 1

HercuIes.title: The Divine Retirement Plan
HercuIes.lore: Son of Zeus, blessed with godlike strength. Uses it exclusively to reach the remote without getting up. Rejected all 12 labors, claiming each was the 13th labor in disguise. Zeus has stopped calling. His legendary strength has carried: snacks, other peoples responsibilities, and exactly zero heroic quests.
HercuIes.recent_developments: Hercules has fully committed to legendary laziness. Zeus stopped calling — blocked his number. The 12 Labors are now a self-help book he wrote (while lying down): Why Heroism is Overrated: A Gods Guide to Doing Nothing. Its a bestseller on Olympus. His strength has carried 4 mountains (for WiFi), 0 heroic quests.
HercuIes.specialty: Divine-tier strength applied to maximum comfort
HercuIes.reputation: Olymps most accomplished underachiever with infinite reserves
HercuIes.stats: Strength GODLIKE | Heroism 0 | Self-Help Books 1 | Mountains Lifted (For Snacks) 4

Bovo.title: The Serene Sovereign (Guild Leader)
Bovo.lore: GUILD LEADER of Tenchu. Leads with calm authority that somehow works despite the chaos around him. His first official act was to appoint five Vice Leaders: loondrops, Iguro, Rohypnol, raiindrops, and Jabilits. His second official act was pretending he knew what he was doing. Nobody noticed. The serene demeanor hides a strategic mind that has seen it all. The crown is heavy. He wears it like it weighs nothing.
Bovo.recent_developments: Bovo has consolidated his reign with surprising effectiveness. The guild has never been more stable — which is like saying a hurricane has been upgraded to organized chaos. His five Vice Leaders handle the guild's chaos while he maintains the calm at the center of the storm. Traditions remain: the betting pools, the chaos, the beautiful disasters. But now there's a serene sovereign at the helm, nodding wisely while the world burns around him.
Bovo.specialty: Serene leadership through absolute chaos management
Bovo.reputation: THE GUILD LEADER who brought order through calm and Vice Leaders through strategy
Bovo.stats: Guild Leader Status | Vice Leaders Appointed 5 | Serenity Level MAX | Strategic Nods Infinity

Huntersung.title: The Sonic Stalker
Huntersung.lore: Sounds like 'Hunter Song' — and that's exactly the problem. Claims to be a legendary hunter tracking fearsome beasts, but their real talent is singing. Enemies don't surrender to the blade. They surrender to make the singing stop. Sings during stealth missions. Somehow still manages to ambush targets — because nobody expects the hunter to be humming show tunes.
Huntersung.recent_developments: Huntersung has developed a combat aria that causes confusion, disorientation, and spontaneous surrendering. The guild has started requesting encores mid-raid. Four demon lords have surrendered specifically to stop the singing. Still claims to be a hunter. The only thing Huntersung hunts is the right note.
Huntersung.specialty: Stealth opera and vocal shock tactics
Huntersung.reputation: The hunter who tracks prey by key signature and defeats them through performance
Huntersung.stats: Enemies Surrendered (To Singing) 47 | Showtunes Memorized 89 | Stealth Missions Compromised Infinity | Hunter Status Disputed

TELUK.title: The Acronym Enigma
TELUK.lore: TELUK is an acronym. Nobody knows what it stands for. TELUK has forgotten. The guild has held 47 meetings to guess. Theories include: 'Tactical Elite Lethal Unit of Knights', 'Totally Epic Legendary Ultra Killer', and 'The Eggs Look Undercooked, Kevin.' TELUK nods at all suggestions. The truth is buried somewhere even TELUK can't find.
TELUK.recent_developments: The mystery of TELUK has become Tenchu's longest-running guessing game. Bovo has declared it an official guild investigation. There is a betting pool (obviously). TELUK has started making up new meanings each week. The acronym expands. The confusion deepens. The answer remains elusive.
TELUK.reputation: The acronym that launched a thousand theories through sheer mystery
TELUK.stats: Acronym Meetings 47 | Theories Proposed 89 | TELUK's Memory 0% | Betting Pool Active

Katnisss.title: The Disappointed District
Katnisss.lore: Joined the guild thinking it was the actual Hunger Games. Was deeply disappointed to discover it's just a gaming guild. Stays for the snacks. Has a bow and arrow she never uses. The three extra S's stand for 'Snacks, Snacks, and Snacks.' Has not survived any hunger games. Has consumed 47 snack varieties.
Katnisss.recent_developments: Katnisss has accepted that there are no actual Hunger Games here. Has channeled survival instincts into snack procurement. Guild pantry inventory: depleted. Her combat readiness: questionable. Her snack readiness: legendary. Still asks if there are districts.
Katnisss.reputation: The tribute who never was but snacks like it's the Capitol
Katnisss.stats: Disappointment Level 99% | Snack Varieties Consumed 47 | Arrows Fired 0 | District Questions Asked Infinity

MiiiMusashi.title: The Stick Saint
MiiiMusashi.lore: Named after the legendary swordsman Miyamoto Musashi — with extra i's for extra sword styles. Carries three swords. Each 'i' represents a different sword technique. Uses none of them. Prefers a stick he found on the ground. The stick is named Steve. Steve has more kills than all three swords combined.
MiiiMusashi.recent_developments: MiiiMusashi's stick — Steve — has become legendary. Enemies fear the stick more than any blade. Has been challenged to duels and brought the stick. The opponents feel insulted. Then they lose. Still carries three swords. Still uses only Steve. The swords are for emotional support.
MiiiMusashi.specialty: Stick combat and emotional support swords
MiiiMusashi.reputation: The three-sword master who kills with a twig and makes it look intentional
MiiiMusashi.stats: Swords Carried 3 | Sword Usage 0% | Stick (Steve) Kills 999 | Opponents Insulted Infinity

Scarlet.title: The Chromatic Confessional
Scarlet.lore: A color. A name. A warning. Literally changes color with mood. Currently: embarrassed. Permanently. Has not stopped being embarrassed since joining the guild. The embarrassment is a state of being. The colors cycle through shame, blush, and crimson. Has accidentally signaled enemy positions by turning bright red.
Scarlet.recent_developments: Scarlet's color-changing has become a guild mood ring. Green means hungry. Blue means thinking about something embarrassing that happened 7 years ago. Red means currently embarrassed (default). Purple means mortified. Has tried meditation to achieve calm beige. Achieved magenta instead. Still blushing. Always.
Scarlet.reputation: The walking mood ring whose default setting is permanent embarrassment
Scarlet.stats: Current Color RED | Colors Achieved 12 | Calm Beige Attempts 47 | Mortification Level 100%

Novocaine.title: The Numb Neutral
Novocaine.lore: Named after the numbing agent — fitting, because they feel no pain. Problem: they feel no pleasure either. Exists in a state of constant emotional neutrality. Not happy. Not sad. Just... present. Enemies can't intimidate them. Allies can't excite them. Novocaine simply is. The ultimate neutral force.
Novocaine.recent_developments: Novocaine's emotional neutrality has been weaponized. Cannot be provoked. Cannot be bargained with. Cannot be tipped. Has walked through enemy lines because nothing was compelling enough to stop. The guild finds them unsettling. Novocaine finds the guild mildly... present. A perfect state of balanced indifference.
Novocaine.reputation: The unfeeling force that cannot be moved because nothing moves them
Novocaine.stats: Emotions Felt 0 | Pleasure Events Missed All | Pain Avoided All | Neutrality Score 100%

Y9 RedzonePlays.title: The Error Code
Y9 RedzonePlays.lore: Y9 is an error code. RedzonePlays is what happens when things glitch. Together, they are a walking system failure. Exists in a state of perpetual bug. Has crashed servers by existing too hard. The guild keeps them around because the glitches are hilarious and occasionally useful.
Y9 RedzonePlays.recent_developments: Y9 RedzonePlays has become Tenchu's unofficial chaos test subject. Every patch is tested against them. If Y9 survives, the patch is stable. Has accidentally teleported, duplicated, and once turned into a chair. The chair was useful in a raid. Error code remains undiagnosed.
Y9 RedzonePlays.specialty: Living system error and accidental utility
Y9 RedzonePlays.reputation: The bug that became a feature and crashes servers as a hobby
Y9 RedzonePlays.stats: Error Codes 47 | Server Crashes 12 | Accidental Teleports 89 | Chair Incidents 1

Trsze.title: The Unpronounceable
Trsze.lore: Nobody knows how to say their name. Trsze has given up correcting people. Answers to anything: 'Hey you,' 'That one,' 'The vowel shortage,' 'Trs.' Has been called 'Tris-knee,' 'Tersez,' 'Trazee,' and 'Sir.' Responds to all of them equally. The name is a test. Everyone fails.
Trsze.recent_developments: The guild has created a Trsze Pronunciation Committee. 12 meetings held. 47 pronunciations attempted. 0 confirmed correct. Trsze responds to all of them with the same nod. Some suspect Trsze doesn't know either. The mystery of the name continues. Trsze remains silent. Trsze remains unnamed.
Trsze.reputation: The vowel-less enigma who answers to everything and confirms nothing
Trsze.stats: Pronunciations Attempted 47 | Correctly Pronounced 0 | Names Answered To Infinity | Vowels Conserved 100%

SEENderELLA.title: The Observed Princess
SEENderELLA.lore: A Cinderella twist: only exists when someone is looking. Turn around? Gone. Blink? Different outfit. Has never been seen consistently by the same person twice. The guild has a 'SEENderELLA Watch' rotation. Eyewitness accounts vary wildly. The only consistent detail: the outfit changes every time.
SEENderELLA.recent_developments: SEENderELLA has weaponized their conditional existence. Enemies can't track what they can't see. Allies can't rely on what vanishes when blinked at. Has appeared in 47 different outfits this month alone. The guild photographer is losing their mind. SEENderELLA is never in the same outfit twice in photos.
SEENderELLA.reputation: The princess who only exists when watched and confuses cameras professionally
SEENderELLA.stats: Observed Existence 100% | Unobserved 100% | Outfit Changes 47/Month | Guild Photographer Sanity 0%

Alluka.title: The Smiling Cataclysm
Alluka.lore: Hunter x Hunter reference — and the smile is not a comfort. Looks innocent enough. Has the power to end worlds. Chooses not to. The smile is not reassurance. The smile is a warning. Alluka asks nicely. You want to say yes.
Alluka.recent_developments: Alluka remains the guild's most politely terrifying member. Has requested things. The things happened. Nobody questions how. Alluka still smiles. The smile means nothing good. The guild has learned to say yes immediately.
Alluka.reputation: The innocent face who ends conflicts before they start through sheer pleasant terror
Alluka.stats: Polite Requests 47 | Worlds Unended (So Far) 12 | Smiles Given Infinity | Immediate Yeses 100%

Shi.title: The Ironic Healer
Shi.lore: Name means 'death' in Japanese. Is a healer. The irony is intentional. Shi finds it hilarious. Enemies see the name 'Shi' and prepare for death. Instead, Shi heals their enemies. The confusion is a tactical advantage. The healing is top-tier. The name is a prank.
Shi.recent_developments: Shi's ironic healing has become legendary. Has entered death-themed areas and started healing people. The irony is not lost. The healing is appreciated. Has been mistaken for a death god 89 times. Has healed 89 times immediately after. Each time: 'Sorry, wrong job.' The prank continues.
Shi.reputation: The healer named death who heals better than anyone named Life
Shi.stats: Mistaken For Death God 89 | Healings Provided 999 | Irony Level MAX | Death Gods Confused Infinity

Appolousa.title: The Corporate Deity
Appolousa.lore: Apollo-like in name and power. Has divine abilities — prophecy, archery, music, the works. Works a 9-to-5 job. The gods need health insurance too. Logs off divine duties to attend Zoom meetings. Has smited enemies while on lunch break. The celestial hierarchy doesn't offer dental.
Appolousa.recent_developments: Appolousa has mastered the work-life-god balance. Divine interventions scheduled during PTO. Prophecies delivered during coffee breaks. Has asked for a raise from Zeus. Zeus redirected to HR. HR doesn't exist. The application is pending. Still doing divine work. Still clocking in.
Appolousa.reputation: The god who works 9-to-5 and smites during approved break times
Appolousa.stats: Divine Powers 100% | PTO Days 12 | HR Complaints Filed 47 | Zeus Redirects Infinity

Sighface.title: The Exhalation Evoker
Sighface.lore: Always sighing. But the sighs are ancient incantations. Each exhale casts a spell. The sadder they look, the more powerful the magic. Has accidentally caused rain by sighing at a cloudy day. A deep sigh once ended a siege. The enemies thought they were sad. They were summoning.
Sighface.recent_developments: Sighface's sighs have been classified as tactical magic. The guild requests specific sighs for specific effects. A tired sigh = minor buff. A heavy sigh = battlefield alteration. A defeated sigh = catastrophe. Sighface is emotionally exhausted. The magic has never been stronger.

cal0y.title: The Silent Zero
cal0y.lore: Filipino nickname with a zero. The 0 is silent. The 0 is also a threat. Nobody asks what it means. cal0y doesn't offer explanations. The zero follows conversations. The zero watches. The zero knows. cal0y fights with the energy of someone who has already accounted for your death.
cal0y.recent_developments: cal0y's zero remains unexplained. The guild has theories. The theories are unsettling. cal0y's combat efficiency: 100%. The zero's involvement: unconfirmed but assumed. Has been seen counting down from 10 before engagements. Nobody asks what happens at 0. The zero doesn't say.

cal0y.stats: Zero Explained 0% | Theories 47 | Combat Efficiency 100% | Countdowns Initiated 89

PabloGaming.title: The Genre Gatekeeper
PabloGaming.lore: Generic gaming channel name. VERY specific gaming. Plays only one genre. That genre is chaos. Not chaos as a theme — chaos as a mechanic. Has 5,000 hours in games that barely exist. Speedruns games that crash if you look at them wrong. Reviews sentient spreadsheets. PabloGaming is a lifestyle.
PabloGaming.recent_developments: PabloGaming has achieved mastery in the chaos genre. Has completed games that don't have endings. Has worlds-first clears of games nobody else plays. The genre of chaos has sub-genres: controlled chaos, uncontrolled chaos, and PabloGaming's personal favorite: 'what is happening' chaos. The content is unwatchable. The skill is undeniable.

YouthNiNam.title: The Youthful Elder
YouthNiNam.lore: 'Youth in Name' — but acts like an ancient being. Has the energy of a retired god. Complains about 'these young adventurers' while being chronologically 23. Talks about 'back in my era' — the era was three months ago. Has declared the guild's music too loud. There is no music playing.
YouthNiNam.recent_developments: YouthNiNam's elderly energy has become a guild meme. Holds court in the guild hall telling tales of 'the old days' (last patch). Has taken up gardening as a hobby. The plants are thriving. The youthful appearance is betrayed by the soul of a 900-year-old librarian. Still young. Still ancient.

Mikmok.title: The Onomatopoeic Avenger
Mikmok.lore: Onomatopoeic. The sound IS the attack. 'Mik' speaks. 'Mok' follows. The order matters. 'Mok-Mik' is a different attack. 'Mik-Mok-Mik' is a combo. The sounds have actual effects. Damage, stun, confusion, existential questioning. Nobody understands the phonetics. Everyone fears them.
Mikmok.recent_developments: Mikmok has expanded their phonetic arsenal. New sounds discovered: 'Bweeu' (knockback), 'Krrrsh' (armor break), 'Fweee' (distraction). The guild has tried to learn the system. The system has no rules. Mikmok doesn't explain. The sounds speak for themselves.

Mikmok.stats: Sounds Mastered 12 | Combos Discovered 47 | Phonetic Rules 0 | Opponent Confusion 100%

CaptainSkad.title: The Backwards Captain
CaptainSkad.lore: Captain of... something. Skad is just 'daks' backwards. Nobody knows what 'daks' is. The captain doesn't either. Commands a ship that may or may not exist. Gives orders that may or may not be real. The crew follows anyway. The faith is commendable. The direction is questionable.
CaptainSkad.recent_developments: CaptainSkad has embraced the mystery. Has promoted a first mate (no ship). Has given sailing orders (no ocean). Has declared mutiny on land. The mutineers didn't know what to mutiny against. The captain remains in command of something. That something remains undefined. The crew remains loyal to the unknown cause.

CaptainSkad.reputation: The captain whose ship, crew, and purpose are unknown but commands absolute respect

sugardrops.title: The Sweet Saboteur
sugardrops.lore: Sweetness as a weapon. The drops are literal sugar. Causes hyperactive chaos on contact. Enemies hit with sugardrops don't take damage — they become unstoppably energetic. Starts dancing. Can't stop. Combat becomes a rave. The sugar high is a tactical debuff.

It was the dancing. We couldn't stop.' Has been banned from 3 bakeries for 'weaponizing the product.' The sweetness continues.

sugardrops.stats: Sugar Rushes Induced 999 | Bakeries Banned From 3 | Kingdoms Affected 4 | Dance Battles Won 47

Winter0315.title: The Date Keeper
Winter0315.lore: March 15th. A date. It happened once. Winter0315 remembers. They're the only one. Something significant occurred on that day. Nobody knows what. Winter0315 won't say. Every March 15th, they become contemplative. The guild has marked it on the calendar: 'Winter0315 Day — Don't Ask.'
Winter0315.recent_developments: The mystery of March 15th deepens. Winter0315 sets reminders. Prepares annually. The event never comes. Or it already came. The timeline is unclear. 福Ryzen.title: The Lucky Processor

Has developed Luck Management protocols: conserve luck during easy fights, spend big on bosses. Crashed 3 times during a raid. Each time, the enemies waited. It's weirdly respectful. Nikudrops.title: The Meat Meteor
Nikudrops.lore: Niku (meat in Japanese) + drops. Drops meat on enemies. It's always perfectly cooked. Medium rare. Seasoned. Enemies don't know whether to dodge or eat. Some have surrendered asking for seconds. The meat is delicious. The damage is secondary.
Nikudrops.recent_developments: Nikudrops has perfected the art of meat-based artillery. Has developed 12 cuts of combat meat. A5 Wagyu for critical hits. Ground beef for area denial. Bacon for persistent damage. Enemies now surrender asking for recipes. The Meat Meteor is feared for its flavor. The grill is always ready.

Bubwit.title: The Kitten Bomb
Bubwit.lore: Sounds cute and small. Deceptively powerful. Like a grenade wrapped in a kitten. Appears harmless. Approaches with innocent eyes. Then the explosion happens. The cuteness is the camouflage. The destruction is absolute.
Bubwit.recent_developments: Bubwit has refined the art of adorable devastation. Enemies don't see it coming because who suspects the cute one? Has eliminated bosses while squeaking. The squeak is the trigger. The explosion follows. The guild calls it the 'Aww-Boom' strategy. It never fails.

Bubwit.stats: Cuteness Level 100% | Explosive Power MAX | Enemies Deceived 999 | Aww-Boom Combo 47

ordips.title: The Reversal Specialist
ordips.lore: Everything is reversed. Attack backwards (retreat toward enemies). Retreat forwards (charge away from danger). Heals deal damage. Damage heals. The confusion is the strategy. 'Go left' means go right. 'I'm fine' means critical. The guild communicates with ordips through interpretive dance. It's the only thing that works.
ordips.recent_developments: ordips has weaponized the reversal. Enemies expect forward attacks — ordips retreats into them. Allies expect healing — ordips damages them (they needed the damage actually). Has learned to speak backwards. The only thing not reversed: the kill count. That stays forward.
ordips.reputation: The backwards warrior who wins by doing everything wrong in the right direction
ordips.stats: Reversal Rate 100% | Allies Confused Infinity | Interpretive Dances Developed 12 | Kill Count (Forward) 999

Shozenn.title: The Aesthetic Appropriator
Shozenn.lore: Sounds Japanese. Not Japanese at all. From a small town nobody's heard of. The name is purely aesthetic. Has never been to Japan. Doesn't know any Japanese. Has a katana collection. All decorative. The aesthetic is the point. The authenticity is optional.
Shozenn.recent_developments: Shozenn has committed to the bit. Has learned Japanese phrases from anime. The pronunciation is... creative. Has visited Japan in a dream once. Counts it. The guild respects the dedication to the aesthetic. The small town origin is more mysterious than any foreign name could be.
Shozenn.reputation: The aesthetically Japanese warrior from a town nobody's heard of with anime pronunciation
Shozenn.stats: Japanese Level 0% | Anime Phrases 47 | Pronunciation Accuracy 12% | Katana Collection (Decorative) 12

Hunter David.title: The Specific Stalker
Hunter David.lore: Hunts specifically people named David. There's a story there. They won't tell it. Every David in a 50-mile radius is a target. Non-Davids are ignored completely. The guild has 3 Davids. They are very nervous. Hunter David watches. The Davids know.
Hunter David.recent_developments: Hunter David's David-hunting has escalated. Has tracked Davids across servers. Has a David-counting system. Current tally: 47. Has spared non-Davids who stood in the way. 'You're not a David. Move.' The Davids are moving. The mystery remains. The hunts continue.

Lieus.title: The Plural Mystery
Lieus.lore: Sounds plural. There might actually be more than one Lieus. Nobody's sure. The guild hasn't counted. Sometimes Lieus is in two places at once. Sometimes they're nowhere. Nobody has confirmed how many there are. Lieus doesn't clarify. The ambiguity is intentional.
Lieus.recent_developments: The Lieus count is a perennial guild debate. Estimates range from 1 to 47. Evidence: Lieus has been seen in 3 places simultaneously. Counter-evidence: it might just be really fast. Lieus has confirmed nothing. The guild has accepted the uncertainty. There are as many Lieus as there need to be.
Lieus.reputation: The potentially plural member whose exact count remains a guild mystery
Lieus.stats: Lieuses Sighted 3 | Confirmed Lieus Count 0 | Guild Guesses 47 | Simultaneous Appearances 12

BuNaLsKi.title: The Capital Chaos
BuNaLsKi.lore: Looks Polish. Not Polish. The letters are random. The capitalization is chaos. B-u-N-a-L-s-K-i — each letter chosen for maximum unpronounceability. The capitals are where BuNaLsKi felt like capitalizing. There is no system. The chaos is the system.
BuNaLsKi.recent_developments: BuNaLsKi has leaned into the letter salad. Has developed a fighting style based on the name: each letter represents a different technique. B: Bash. u: underhand strike. N: Ninja vanish. Nobody can predict the next letter. Neither can BuNaLsKi. The chaos is the strategy.
BuNaLsKi.specialty: Random letter combat and capitalization chaos
BuNaLsKi.reputation: The letter salad whose name is a keyboard smash and fighting style is improv

Yunseri.title: The Eternal Tease
Yunseri.lore: Sounds like 'You'll see.' Nobody has seen anything yet. Yunseri keeps promising. Keeps not delivering. 'Just wait.' 'Soon.' 'You'll see.' Nobody has seen. The anticipation is eternal. The payoff is theoretical.
Yunseri.recent_developments: Yunseri's promises have become legendary. 'I'll show you my ultimate technique.' (Hasn't.) 'Next week, I'll reveal everything.' (Hasn't.) 'Just one more level.' (It's been 47 levels.) The guild has stopped waiting. The anticipation is self-sustaining. Yunseri keeps promising. The cycle continues.
Yunseri.reputation: The promise machine whose deliveries are always coming and never arriving
Yunseri.stats: Promises Made 999 | Promises Kept 0 | 'You'll See's Uttered Infinity | Guild Patience 3%

xSerissa.title: The Moving Mark
xSerissa.lore: x + Serissa (flower). The x marks a spot. The spot keeps moving. Can't be pinned down. x marks where xSerissa was. Never where xSerissa is. Leaves x marks everywhere. The guild follows the x's. Always one step behind.
xSerissa.recent_developments: xSerissa has turned the moving x into a game. Leaves x marks across the guild hall. The x's form patterns. The patterns lead nowhere. Some say the x's spell messages. Others say xSerissa is just messing with everyone. The x's continue. The spots keep moving.
xSerissa.reputation: The moving x that marks where they were and never where they are
xSerissa.stats: x Marks Left 999 | Spots Moved Infinity | Patterns Deciphered 0 | Locations Confirmed 0

oLuke.title: The Essential Prefix
oLuke.lore: o + Luke. The 'o' is for oxygen. Without it, they'd be just Luke. Dead Luke. The 'o' is essential. Has nearly died when someone forgot the 'o.' Now always introduces themselves with emphasis: 'O-Luke. The O matters.' The guild has it in writing. The O stays.
oLuke.recent_developments: oLuke has made the O their entire identity. Has created an O-based combat style. The O is a shield. The O is a battle cry. 'O!' Luke follows. Enemies are confused by the emphasis. The O has saved lives. Luke without O is not Luke. The O remains.
oLuke.reputation: The one whose O is the difference between breathing and not — and they never let you forget
oLuke.stats: O's Essential 100% | Near-Death O-Missing Incidents 3 | O-Based Techniques 12 | Emphasis Level MAX

IlllIlllI.title: The Unreadable

IlllIlllI.recent_developments: IlllIlllI has embraced the unreadability. Has become the guild's master of disguise — because nobody can identify them anyway. The name is a camouflage. The camouflage is accidental. The effectiveness is undeniable. Still responds to 'hey you.' Still hasn't been properly addressed.

newking.title: The Sand Sovereign
newking.lore: New king, old kingdom. The kingdom is a sandbox. Rules with absolute authority over sand. Has declared sandcastles official guild architecture. Enemies who step on the sandbox face royal wrath. The jurisdiction is limited. The authority is unquestionable. The sand is the domain.
newking.recent_developments: The Sand Kingdom has expanded. Newking has built a sand empire. Trade routes established (sand-based). Economy runs on imaginary currency. Foreign policy: aggressive toward anyone who kicks sand. The kingdom may be small. The authority is absolute. All hail the sand king.

AliceXII.title: The Clone Chronicles
AliceXII.lore: Alice XII — the 12th clone. The first 11 didn't work out. This one's fine. Probably. Has memories that aren't hers. Sometimes hears the other Alices. Forgets which Alice she is. Has Alice-only problems. The guild doesn't ask which number they're talking to.
AliceXII.recent_developments: AliceXII exhibits Clone Degradation Syndrome. Occasionally switches to Alice V's personality mid-sentence. Has Alice VII's combat preferences. Occasionally confuses enemies with Alice III's tactics. The original Alice is lost to time. AliceXII is the best version so far. The bar was low.

Jakeeeee.title: The Exponential E
Jakeeeee.lore: Jake with many e's. Each 'e' is a kill count. The name keeps getting longer. Was just 'Jake' when they started. Now 'Jakeeeee' with 6 e's. Has promised to add another e when they reach the next milestone. The name is a living kill counter. At this rate, the name will crash chat boxes.
Jakeeeee.recent_developments: Jakeeeee's kill count is outpacing the alphabet. 6 e's so far. Guild mathematicians estimate 12 e's by year end. Jakeeeee has started using emoji as e substitutes. The kill counter continues. The name expands. The letters can't keep up.

只rylai.title: The Hidden Translation
只rylai.lore: Chinese character + rylai. The Chinese character (只) says something completely different from what they tell people. Tells everyone it means 'pure.' It means 'only' or 'single.' The translation is a lie. The lie is maintained. Nobody has checked. The secret is safe (for now).

jPOLA.title: The Volume Balance

Vαηвιѕ.title: The Font Phantom

loondrops.title: The Drop Zone Commander (Vice Leader)
loondrops.lore: VICE LEADER of Tenchu under Bovo. Commands attention like a drop in a still pond — subtle, inevitable, and causing ripples. Handles guild operations with calm precision. The guild listens when loondrops speaks. The drops are never late. The zone is always secure.

raiindrops.title: The Storm Gatherer (Vice Leader)
raiindrops.lore: VICE LEADER of Tenchu under Bovo. More i's for more intensity. Commands the weather of guild morale — brings storms when needed, clears skies when necessary. The extra 'i's stand for intensity, intelligence, and 'I'm in charge here.'
raiindrops.recent_developments: As Vice Leader, raiindrops manages guild morale and weather patterns (both literal and metaphorical). The storm follows where she goes. Enemies flee from the forecast. The guild basks in the controlled chaos she brings. Those extra i's carry weight.
raiindrops.specialty: Vice Leader of Morale and atmospheric warfare
raiindrops.reputation: VICE LEADER whose storms are always on target and on time
raiindrops.stats: Vice Leader Status | Storm Control 100% | Extra I Power MAX | Morale Management INFINITY

Jabilits.title: The Jade Commander (Vice Leader)
Jabilits.lore: VICE LEADER of Tenchu under Bovo. Named like a jewel, commands like a general. Jabilits rose through the ranks through sheer competence — a rare commodity in a guild where chaos is currency. Handles guild defense and combat strategy. The jade is unbreakable. The command is absolute.
Jabilits.recent_developments: As Vice Leader, Jabilits has fortified Tenchu's defenses and streamlined combat operations. The guild has never been better protected. Enemies think twice before engaging. Bovo sleeps easier knowing the defenses are in capable hands. The jade shines brightest under pressure.
Jabilits.specialty: Vice Leader of Defense & strategic combat command
Jabilits.reputation: VICE LEADER whose jade composure masks iron discipline
Jabilits.stats: Vice Leader Status | Defense Rating MAX | Combat Strategy 100% | Jade Power INFINITE

AndyVI_alt.title: The Alt Identity Crisis
AndyVI_alt.lore: Claims to be the main account. The original AndyVI is actually the alt. Identity crisis in royal form. Has the same ambitions as AndyVI but insists on priority. The puddle kingdom now has a succession dispute. The gnome is caught in the middle.
AndyVI_alt.recent_developments: AndyVI_alt has demanded recognition as the true Andy. Has presented evidence (forged). Has witnesses (paid). The original AndyVI is confused. The puddle kingdom now has two claimants. The gnome has formed a committee. The dispute continues. The chaos is constitutional.
AndyVI_alt.specialty: Royal succession dispute and alt-main identity crisis
AndyVI_alt.reputation: The alt who claims to be the main in a puddle kingdom identity crisis
AndyVI_alt.stats: Claimed Priority Primary | Evidence Veracity 0% | Witness Integrity Questionable | Puddle Subjects Confused
